learned.text: Celestica has a named (unidentified customer) hyperscaler rack-scale AI-networking design win with mass production starting within 2026, plus a raised FY26 guide ($20.5bn revenue / $11.30 adj. EPS). Oct 27 2026 investor day is the next dated catalyst. This is the standing structural mechanism behind Compute/Hyperscaler OEM cluster strength, distinct from any single day's price print.

WD and Seagate both announced across-the-board HDD price hikes in September 2026; NAND flash prices have roughly doubled in six months as wafer capacity shifts to HBM. Goldman raised its WDC PT to $650 from $400. TrendForce's 08-25 forecast (already in HBMTracker consumer_view.json) of enterprise-SSD +235% cumulative 2026 corroborates the same crowding-out mechanism.

COHR fully exited 2026-09-23 via stop-loss. No negative company catalyst found: PhotonLink AI-datacenter optics platform launched 09-21, Stifel/Needham both bullish (PT raised to $420). The -3.5% session (09-22) followed a +21% five-session run. Reads as a technical/sizing stop-out catching a pullback after a sharp run, not a thesis break -- flagged to thesis this run.

IREN (new position, 1.2% equity) is a second debt/impairment-funded neocloud alongside NBIS, both currently unclassified/mixed rather than cleanly mapped to a cluster. This compounds rather than resolves the G98 cluster-purity gap (NBIS sitting in Compute/Hyperscaler alongside self-funded MSFT/GOOG/AMZN) -- worth resolving together when cluster assignment for the recent adds (IREN, CBRS, LRCX) is next done.
